mechanism: Nafcillin induces CYP3A4 metabolism, potentially reducing dapagliflozin exposure; concurrent use may also increase risk of genital infections due to SGLT2 inhibitor glycosuria combined with nafcillin's broad spectrum coverage.
action: Monitor glycemic control closely and assess for reduced dapagliflozin efficacy; increased genital mycotic infection monitoring recommended; consider alternative antibiotic if available.
